title: Molecular insights into the activation of Mre11-Rad50 endonuclease activity by Sae2/CtIP.
authors: Nicolas, Yoann; Bret, Helene; Cannavo, Elda; Acharya, Ananya; Cejka, Petr; Borde, Valerie; Guerois, Raphael
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2建模结合生化遗传实验揭示Sae2/CtIP激活Mre11-Rad50核酸酶切割DNA的机制，属蛋白质-DNA互作的结构建模研究，但聚焦核酸酶而非TF-DNA转录结合体系，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: In Saccharomyces cerevisiae (S. cerevisiae), Mre11-Rad50-Xrs2 (MRX)-Sae2 nuclease activity is required for the resection of DNA breaks with secondary structures or protein blocks, while in humans, the MRE11-RAD50-NBS1 (MRN) homolog with CtIP is needed to initiate DNA end resection of all breaks. Phosphorylated Sae2/CtIP stimulates the endonuclease activity of MRX/N. Structural insights into the activation of the Mre11 nuclease are available only for organisms lacking Sae2/CtIP, so little is known about how Sae2/CtIP activates the nuclease ensemble. Here, we uncover the mechanism of Mre11 activation by Sae2 using a combination of AlphaFold2 structural modeling of biochemical and genetic assays. We show that Sae2 stabilizes the Mre11 nuclease in a conformation poised to cleave substrate DNA. Several designs of compensatory mutations establish how Sae2 activates MRX in vitro and in vivo, supporting the structural model. Finally, our study uncovers how human CtIP, despite considerable sequence divergence, employs a similar mechanism to activate MRN.
abstract_zh: 在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中，Mre11-Rad50-Xrs2（MRX）-Sae2核酸酶活性对于具有二级结构或蛋白质阻断的DNA断裂的切除是必需的，而在人类中，与CtIP同源的MRE11-RAD50-NBS1（MRN）复合物则需启动所有断裂的DNA末端切除。磷酸化的Sae2/CtIP刺激MRX/N的核酸内切酶活性。关于Mre11核酸酶激活的结构见解仅适用于缺乏Sae2/CtIP的生物体，因此对于Sae2/CtIP如何激活核酸酶复合物的了解甚少。在此，我们通过结合AlphaFold2结构建模与生化及遗传分析，揭示了Sae2激活Mre11的机制。我们表明，Sae2将Mre11核酸酶稳定在一种准备切割底物DNA的构象中。多种补偿性突变设计确立了Sae2如何在体外和体内激活MRX，从而支持该结构模型。最后，我们的研究揭示了人类CtIP尽管序列差异显著，却采用类似机制激活MRN。
